==Skin Upgrades==
The '''Gatling Gun''' has two skins. This includes:
#The Default skin.
#One skin that can be unlocked from [[Passes]].
{{Tabber
|Default
|{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = Default
|Icon1 = [[File:DefaultGatlingGunIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:GatlingGun01.png|200px]]
|Operator is the player's avatar forced to R6 and without any dynamic clothing.

Grey and green M2 Browning with a green ammunition box, on a tripod grey and green mount.
|[[File:GatlingGun01.png|200px]]
|No change.
|[[File:GatlingGun2.png|200px]] 
|M2 Browning is now mostly grey, with a green shield at the front.

Ammunition box is now lighter, lid is now on the side instead of on top of it.

Now on a quadpod mount, which is mostly grey.
|[[File:GatlingGun3.png|200px]]
|Double-barreled M2 Browning with two ammunition boxes. Expanded shield now covers both sides of the operator.

Green parts are now light blue.
|[[File:GatlingGun4.png|200px]]
|Operator is now seated.

Mount legs are now a stand.

M2 Browning replaced with a turret minigun, covered by more shield.
|[[File:GatlingGun5.png|200px]]
|Stand and turret minigun is now mostly covered in green armor.

Operator is protected by a green panel, with a small viewing window at the top.
|[[File:GatlingGun6.png|200px]]
|Even more armor plating on the weapon.

Protective panel for operator removed, now has a camera at the front to see enemies with.

Armor is now black.

Turret minigun is now bigger.
}}
|Easter
|The {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Easter}} skin was obtained from Level 15 of the [[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Battle Pass]] premium track.
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Easter}}
|Icon1 = [[File:EasterGatlingGunnerIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:EasterGatlingGun01.png|200px]]
|Operator is the player's avatar forced to R6 and without any dynamic clothing.

Orange and blue M2 Browning with a blue ammunition box and an orange tip, on a tripod blue white and orange mount.
|[[File:EasterGatlingGun01.png|200px]]
|No change.
|[[File:EasterGatlingGun2.png|200px]] 
|M2 Browning now has a blue shield at the front.

Ammunition box is now lighter, lid is now on the side instead of on top of it.

Now on a quadpod mount, which is blue white and orange.
|[[File:EasterGatlingGun3.png|200px]]
|Double-barreled M2 Browning with two ammunition boxes. Expanded shield now covers both sides of the operator.

Blue parts of the shield are now white, blue parts of legs being orange.
|[[File:EasterGatlingGun4.png|200px]]
|Operator is now seated.

Mount legs are now a stand.

M2 Browning replaced with a turret minigun, covered by more shield.

Color scheme is now mostly blue with a white stripe.
|[[File:EasterGatlingGun5.png|200px]]
|Stand and turret minigun is now mostly covered in blue and orange armor.

Operator is protected by a green panel, with a small viewing window at the top.
|[[File:EasterGatlingGun6.png|200px]]
|Even more armor plating on the weapon.

Protective panel for operator removed, now has a camera at the front to see enemies with.

Armor is now blue with orange and yellow accents.

Turret minigun is now bigger.
}}
}}

==Skin Trivia==
*The colors of the {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Easter}} skin are based on NERF dart blasters, as a large amount of them use a blue and orange color scheme.

==Update History==
*'''18 September 2024''' - [[v1.32.0]]
**'''Gatling Gun''' added.
*'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]]
**New skin: {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Easter}}
**{{Bug}} {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Easter}} skin gun is not properly attached to the gun tripod or quadpod.
*'''9 July 2025''' - [[V1.70.0]]
**{{Bugfix}} {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Easter}} skin gun now is attached properly to the gun tripod or quadpod.
